items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: Walking after a meal is linked to a smaller rise in sugar, with the most gain from walks of 10 to 19 minutes. If you take insulin or a sulfonylurea, ask your care team about low sugar before adding walks after meals.

items.title: Keep dinner early
items.text: Having dinner before 8 pm is linked to a smaller rise in sugar, as sugar rose about 9.2 mg/dL more after late dinners. Only 12.5% of your dinners started at 8 pm or later, so keep it that way.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: Your overnight fast averaged 12.9 hours, which is a good habit to keep as it may be linked to sugar. In the program, adding the overnight fast to coaching changed the result by -0.03 points compared with coaching alone.
